name: NorthTec Tai Tokerau Wananga
description:
NorthTec is a post-secondary higher education provider in Northland, New Zealand. The provider has several campuses across Northland in Auckland, Whangarei, Kaikohe, Kaitaia, Kerikeri, and Dargaville.

Since opening in 1978, the institution has grown to offer courses at foundation, certificate, diploma and degree levels. Students can now access around 100 courses in subjects like Business, Computing and IT, Nursing, Teaching, Engineering and more.

Education at NorthTec is challenging, varied, and exciting. You can choose from a wide range of courses, from nursing to construction.

NorthTecâ€™s Auckland International campus became the first centre in New Zealand to be approved by Immigration New Zealand for the Pearson Test of English Academic (PTE Academic)

Across its several campuses, NorthTec has plenty of resources that students can access. The campus also has fitness and gym facilities at its health centre. Students can also socialise at The Apprentice Restaurant and student cafe and take in cultural events at the Geoff Wilson Art Gallery.

Student Life

Students from various countries and continents attend NorthTec each year. Due to this, a diverse, welcoming and supportive culture is present across all campuses. International students can also receive help and guidance from highly qualified and trained staff. 

The university also has an active Student Representation and Student Council. Students are encouraged to join these groups to become part of the institutionâ€™s community. In addition, these groups run and promote various student events throughout the year, which include welcome opportunities and off-campus trips.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: NorthTec, known in te reo Māori as Tai Tokerau Wānanga, is a public tertiary education provider based in Whangārei, New Zealand. They offer you a wide range of qualifications, from certificates to diplomas and degrees, across diverse fields such as nursing, Māori arts, construction, business, primary industries, and applied sciences. Plus, NorthTec is accredited by the New Zealand Qualifications Authority (NZQA).

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: As an international student, you’ll be in a diverse and supportive learning environment, with students from all over the world. The institution has an active Student Representation team and Student Council that organises a range of events throughout the year. Plus, with NorthTec’s Student Support Services, you can get learning support, advice about course planning, and more. NorthTec also offers you confidential counselling services and wellbeing initiatives for free.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
NorthTec does not provide on-campus accommodation. However, the institution offers guidance and support to help you secure stay options nearby. You can also opt for a homestay with one of NorthTec’s vetted local families.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
At the main Whangarei campus, you’ll find a library with course books, computer resources and study areas.

Cafeteria
The Apprentice Cafe and Restaurant at the Whangārei campus is your spot to get a quick lunch or coffee.
